ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel distribution covering approximately 90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels are localized in small speckles and high-contrast fringe elements at the tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive low-contrast mottling across both lobes. Discrete dark-to-medium grey contiguous clusters are visible on the right lobe, while the left lobe shows more uniform dark pixel density with sparse lighter grey focal spots near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle at the vertex is approximately 80 degrees with a high-depth bounding box relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude serrations at the distal tips, presenting as finger-like projections or fringes. The inner sections of the trailing edge adjacent to the notch exhibit lower-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a primarily linear sweep from the median notch, transitioning into irregular convex curves before terminating at the heavily eroded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters are detected at the extreme terminal tips of both lobes; isolated white punctate markings are scattered sparsely across the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel dark linear pixel disruptions are visible on the left lobe, extending diagonally from the anterior region towards the mid-trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural fragmentation and tissue irregularity at both distal ends, resulting in an atypical shredded or fringed appearance of the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme degree of erosion on the terminal edges creates a highly unique, ragged 'comb' effect that is distinct from standard species morphology.
